author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads the TeamViewer event log (Tensor license), which is only available from POST /api/v2/EventLogging. The bridge in bridges/teamviewer-event-logs pulls it and posts each event unchanged to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration. Every event goes to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- TeamViewer has no syslog or push export.
- Its event log (Tensor license, turned on by a company admin) is only available from POST /api/v2/EventLogging, so bridges/teamviewer-event-logs pulls it and posts each event unchanged to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration.

Field mapping:
- Every event goes to CloudAudit: the event name and type, the author's email and name, the affected item, and the first three EventDetails as property name and new value (plus the first old value).
- Session events aren't marked as management events.

Sources and licenses:
- Event names and types come from TeamViewer's Web API spec.

Made up in the samples:
- The spec doesn't document EventDetails property names or the affected item for each event, so those sample values are made up, as are all others.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (55 of 55 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
